# freeloremipsum.app

> Free online lorem ipsum generator — no login, no cloud, no tracking.

## Overview

freeloremipsum.app is a free, browser-based lorem ipsum placeholder text generator. It runs entirely client-side with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. No backend, no accounts, no data collection.

## Key Facts

- 100% free, no login required
- Generates paragraphs, sentences, words, or list items
- Quantity range: 1–100 units per generation
- Word bank: 200+ unique Latin-style words
- Optional HTML tags output (<p>, <ul><li>)
- Optional classic "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet…" opening
- Dark mode with persistent preference
- All processing happens locally in the browser
- No data is transmitted to any server
- Loads in under 200ms

## Features

- Four output types: paragraphs, sentences, words, list items
- Randomized sentence length (8–20 words) and paragraph length (40–80 words)
- Real-time statistics: word count, sentence count, paragraph count, character count
- One-click copy to clipboard
- Keyboard shortcut: Cmd/Ctrl + Enter to generate
- Mobile responsive, touch-friendly
